fields.display_title: This paper proposes an annealing stochastic gradient descent (SGD) approach for efficiently training Gaussian Mixture Models  on non-stationary, high-dimensional streaming data. Although it is well organized and the idea is acceptable and the traning process is clearly described, I still concern its originality and effectiveness. Moreover, its functions for non-stationary, high-dimensional streaming data are not analyzed and tested deeply.
